† [שְׁלֵם] vb. be complete (v. BH; Egyptian Aramaic שלם pay in full Cooke404 = S-CL 5. 7);—
Pe. Pt. pass. שְׁלִם Ezr 5:16 finished, of temple.
Haph. Pf. 3 ms. sf. הַשְׁלְמַהּ Dn 5:26 God has finished it (the kingdom; brought it to an end); Imv. ms. הַשְׁלֵם Ezr 7:19 render in full, acc. rei (cf. Syriac Aph., Be-Ry Berthol), sq. קֳדָם dei.
